resources.string: Connect a USB DAC to configure DoP.
Enable only if this DAC supports DoP. Saved for its USB vendor and product ID. PCM sample rates do not confirm DoP support.
Requires USB bit-perfect mode. Higher rates still require the matching DAC clock; unsupported output stops without converting to PCM.
Enable DoP for this DAC and select a maximum DSD rate covering this track, then restart playback.
